answer: Cap how fast new identities can mature and earn, so a flood cannot overrun the system at once. Treat each epoch's intake like a lantern admitting only a few travellers toward the horizon, and let rewards flow solely from protocol emission, never from deposits an attacker controls. Referral credit climbs the vine slowly and pays only when the invitee does honest graded work, so buying a crowd of fakes yields only a crowd of liabilities.
